profile.name: Drive Vault
profile.description: Keeps your bots' shared computer from running out of space by safely moving old files to Google Drive, and turns any file into a Drive link you can download on your phone.

memory.content: For video deliveries, ask the user at the time whether they want the final video uploaded to Drive for phone download, rather than uploading automatically.

plugins.name: Google Drive
plugins.description: Search, read, create, and share files.
